title: Reskill QA automation toward AI-assisted quality
description: Invest in upskilling the product quality function with AI-assisted test design and regression analysis.
rationale: Product quality priority requires automation depth plus AI literacy; reskilling is lower risk than external hiring for this niche.

title: Adjust platform team staffing for reliability sprint
description: Temporarily increase platform engineering capacity for observability and incident response work.
rationale: Platform reliability KPI trending below target; cross-team allocation supports priority without permanent headcount change.

title: Evolve QA Automation Lead role toward AI Product Quality Lead
description: Redesign the QA automation lead responsibilities to include AI-assisted quality analytics and product partnership.
rationale: Role evolution aligns quality leadership with AI enablement while preserving human ownership of release decisions.

title: Fund quality analytics learning cohort
description: Allocate L&D budget for data analysis and test automation workshops for product engineering.
rationale: Closing data analysis supply gap supports both quality automation and onboarding revamp priorities.
